rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Each month of use for each affected unit may be a separate violation.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation (per unit per month)
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential dwelling units in San Francisco using algorithmic pricing devices relying on nonpublic competitor data.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses an algorithmic device that relies on nonpublic competitor data

rules.penalty: Tenants may seek damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use per affected unit may be a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as month (October 2024).

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices that rely on nonpublic competitor data to set or recommend rents or occupancy; tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation (per month per affected property)
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental property in San Diego using algorithmic pricing devices.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses a covered algorithmic device

rules.penalty: Tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source; effective date given only as month (June 2025).

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents; violations recur per unit per month and tenants have private remedies.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses a coordinated pricing algorithm

rules.penalty: Recurring unit/month violations and private remedies.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al. , (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source; RealPage challenge was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026; effective date given only as month.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Landlords may not engage in specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; tenants may bring private claims.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses automated rent price-fixing tools

rules.penalty: Private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source; municipal code section not given.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services; enforced by public and private actions.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses an algorithmic rent coordination service

rules.penalty: Public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm summary; citation and effective date (month only) not verified against official code.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses covered software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms

rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source cites 'ch. 158-2'; may correspond to Chapter 158 Article II. Effective date given only as month.
